# Tsukaima (使い魔) Design System

Tsukaima is a native Android client for Hermes Agent (the open-source autonomous agent by Nous Research). The agent runs remotely; Tsukaima is the familiar bound to it — a fast, minimal mobile surface for chatting with your agent, watching it work, approving tool calls and switching models. Single-user, self-hosted, one Hermes instance. No account, no cloud middleman.

**Sources provided:** brand brief (pasted text) and an app mark (`uploads/tsukaima.svg`, generated by the maintainer). No GitHub repo, no Figma, no font binaries.

## Product surfaces
One product in two surfaces: the Tsukaima Android app (phone, unfolded foldable, web) and a single-page project site.

### App information architecture
Grouped by what you'd touch from a phone (see `ui_kits/tsukaima/README.md` for the API mapping). **Primary:** Status (home — gateway state + start/stop/restart, pairing, continue/new chat), Chat, Sessions (the drawer, grouped by profile, long-press to rename/archive/delete), Cron (run now / pause / edit / delete). **Secondary, in Settings:** profile, model, skills + toolsets toggles, pairing, logs, usage, admin-dashboard link, theme. No tab bar: the drawer is the whole navigation; Status is home. Destructive actions = long-press menu + confirm dialog. Config/env/MCP/webhooks/PTY are left to the desktop dashboard on purpose. Screens: chat (with approval card + collapsed tool call), conversation drawer, settings (server URL + token, model picker, theme), onboarding/empty state.

## Content fundamentals
- **Voice:** quiet, precise, lowercase-leaning calm. Second person for the user ("Your agent is thinking"), third person for the agent. The agent is referred to as "your agent" or by profile name — never "the AI".
- **Casing:** sentence case everywhere. No ALL CAPS except tiny meta labels (letter-spaced, 11px). No exclamation marks.
- **Status language is editorial, not technical:** "Thinking…", "Running shell command", "Waiting for your approval", "Idle" — short serif lines, present tense.
- **Thinking flair:** while the agent thinks, the status line cycles through verbs with Japanese pop-culture energy, always in the quiet serif italic — "Summoning…", "Charging ki…", "Powering up…", "Channeling…", "Reading the scroll…", "Consulting the shrine…", "Steeping matcha…", "Folding cranes…", "Sharpening the blade…", "Drawing the seal…", "Chanting…", "Gathering spirit energy…", "Training arc…", "Unlocking the next form…", "Meditating under the waterfall…", "Rolling the gacha…", "Inking the next panel…", "Grinding XP…", "Binding the contract…". A second set (`THINKING_FLAIR_WATCHLIST`) carries one allusive line per anime the maintainer rated 9+ on MyAnimeList (source: https://myanimelist.net/animelist/mario972?status=7&order=4) — never quotes, only nods: "Tuning the phone microwave…", "Walking the tiger home…", "Granting a five-yen wish…", "Casting Explosion, once a day…", "Diving into the net…". Full lists in `components/chat/StatusLine.jsx`. Tool-running and approval states stay literal.
- **No emoji.** The kanji 使い魔 is the only ornamental glyph, used as a small secondary mark (wordmark lockup, empty state) — nowhere else.
- **Buttons:** single verbs — "Approve", "Deny", "Save", "Connect".
- Examples: empty state → "Your familiar is listening." ; approval card → "Hermes wants to run a tool" ; settings helper → "Paste the token from your Hermes instance."

## Visual foundations
- **Surfaces:** warm cream, never pure white. Page `#F7F4ED`, raised cards `#FFFDF7`, sunken wells `#EFEAE0`. Dark mode: warm near-black `#1B1917` / `#242120`.
- **Accent:** muted lavender-mauve `#7C6FCF` (mid-depth — white text/icons pass contrast). Pressed `#6A5EBF`. Pale tint `#C9C2F0` for *selected states only* — never text, never buttons. Softer tint `#EAE6F8` is the user bubble fill. Dark mode accent `#A89CFF` (dark ink on it). Accent appears only on: send button, active/selected states, agent presence dot, approval card actions.
- **Ink:** warm near-black `#272220`; secondary `#5D564E`; tertiary `#746B61`.
- **Type:** humanist serif (Source Serif 4) for wordmark, screen titles, agent status/thinking lines. Neutral sans (Instrument Sans) for chat + UI. Mono (IBM Plex Mono) for code. Kanji in Noto Serif JP. Serif is the brand signature; it never sets body chat text.
- **Spacing:** 4dp base; page gutters 20dp; generous whitespace — screens breathe, chrome is nearly absent.
- **Radii:** 12dp (rows, chips via pill, inputs), 16dp (cards, bubbles), 28dp (composer pill). Nothing sharper than 12 except code blocks inside prose (10).
- **Shadows:** almost none. Only the composer and the approval card carry a soft warm shadow (`0 2px 12px rgba(60,50,40,.10)`). Everything else separates by surface tone or a hairline border `#E6E0D4`.
- **Borders:** 1px hairlines in warm grey; no heavy outlines. Focus = 2px accent ring.
- **Backgrounds:** flat color only. No gradients, no textures, no imagery. The one permitted filled-accent surface is the Approve button on the approval card.
- **Animation:** quiet. 150–200ms ease-out fades/translates; status dot pulses slowly (2s) while thinking/running. No bounces.
- **States:** hover (desktop preview) = 4% ink wash; press = 8% ink wash, no shrink; selected = pale lavender tint fill + accent text.
- **Status line states:** idle (grey dot), thinking (lavender, pulsing, flair verbs), running tool (lavender, pulsing), waiting for approval (amber), gateway stopped / can't reach Hermes (red). Red is reserved for these two.
- **Chrome:** top bar (model chip left, overflow right), no tab bar, drawer for history/profiles/settings, full-width rounded composer. Material 3 baseline; default theme is this fixed warm palette (Material You dynamic color optional).
- **Wide layouts (unfolded Z Fold, tablet, web):** at ≥720dp the drawer becomes a persistent 300dp list pane on the left (hairline divider, no shadow) and the drawer button disappears; chat is a single centered column, max 760dp, so prose never runs wide. Composer and approval card keep their width with the column. Nothing else changes — no extra panes, no sidebars.
- **Anti-references:** not Material default purple, not dark hacker terminal, not neon anime. Quiet.

## Mark
The mark is a single lavender speech-loop with a tail — a chat bubble that reads as a tether between master and familiar. Files in `assets/`: `mark.svg` (#7C6FCF, for cream), `mark-dark.svg` (#A89CFF, for dark), `mark-on-accent.svg` (white, on accent), `mark-ink.svg`, `app-icon.svg`/`.png` (1024 launcher tile on cream). Lockup: mark at cap-height-plus of the serif wordmark, 16dp gap, 使い魔 small and vertical to the right. Never recolor outside the palette, never add outlines or shadows.

**Empty-state illustration:** `assets/resting-wisp.svg` (`-dark` variant) — a curled, sleeping fox-like familiar drawn as one continuous 4px line in tertiary ink. Used only on the onboarding/empty state, below the wordmark, ~200dp wide, 80% opacity. Never on the accent, never filled, never animated beyond a fade-in.

## Iconography
No icon assets were provided. The system uses **Material Symbols Rounded** (Google CDN, weight 300, 20–24dp) — fits the Material 3 baseline; rounded cut matches the soft radii. Loaded in `tokens/fonts.css`. Usage: inked `--ink-2` by default, accent only when the element is active. No emoji, no hand-drawn SVGs. Wordmark is plain Source Serif 4 type "Tsukaima" with 使い魔 (Noto Serif JP) as small secondary mark, optionally led by the mark (see above).

## Implementation decisions (for the Android build)
- **Attach** uploads files and images into the current session's workspace (cwd); the message then references them by path. No inline image rendering in v1.
- **Push notifications** (actionable where noted): approval requests (Approve/Deny on the notification), pairing requests (Approve/Revoke), agent finished a long task, gateway stopped / Hermes unreachable, cron job failed.
- **Theme default:** follow system. Warm palette in light, warm near-black in dark; Material You dynamic color is opt-in.
- **使い魔:** bundle a 3-glyph subset of Noto Serif JP (使 い 魔) rather than the full font.
- **Units:** every px in this system is 1dp; type sizes are sp. Line-heights are unitless multipliers.
- **Fonts:** bundle Source Serif 4, Instrument Sans, IBM Plex Mono as TTF/variable (all SIL OFL). Material Symbols Rounded via the Compose `material-icons-extended` equivalent or bundled font, weight 300.
- **Offline:** cached sessions open read-only; composer disabled; status line red "Can’t reach Hermes"; Status home shows last-known facts at 55% opacity with a Retry.
- **Streaming:** assistant text appends token-by-token with a blinking 2dp lavender caret; status line reads "Replying…" while streaming.
- **Loading:** skeleton blocks (sunken cream, slow pulse) for session history and lists; never spinners.
- **Destructive actions:** always long-press (480ms) menu → confirm dialog. Delete is red-ink outlined, never filled.

## Fonts — substitution flag
No font files were provided. Google Fonts stand-ins (flagged for replacement if real brand fonts exist): Source Serif 4 (serif), Instrument Sans (sans), IBM Plex Mono (mono), Noto Serif JP (kanji). All loaded via Google Fonts in `tokens/fonts.css`.

## Intentional additions
- `Icon` wrapper component — single entry point for Material Symbols glyphs (keeps name/size/tone consistent).

## Index
- `styles.css` → imports `tokens/fonts.css`, `tokens/colors.css`, `tokens/typography.css`, `tokens/spacing.css`, `tokens/elevation.css`
- `assets/` — mark variants + app icon
- `guidelines/` — foundation specimen cards (colors, type, spacing, radii, shadows, brand)
- `components/core/` — Button, IconButton, TextField, Switch, Chip, Card, Icon, Row, Dialog, Menu, Skeleton
- `components/chat/` — UserBubble, AssistantMessage, CodeBlock, ToolRow, ApprovalCard, PairingCard, StatusLine, Composer
- `components/chrome/` — TopBar, Drawer, ConversationItem
- `ui_kits/tsukaima/` — interactive app recreation: `index.html` phone, `dark.html` phone dark, `foldable.html` Z Fold unfolded, `web.html` desktop
- `ui_kits/site/` — project landing page
- `SKILL.md` — agent-skill entry point
- `HANDOFF.md` — developer handoff: every screen specified, state, tokens, decisions
